selection: Order eligible fixed 100 m UTM cells by SHA256 of region and projected southwest corner. Keep in order subject to separation and cap. Use all registered boxes including zero yield. No replacements.
rationale: 400 square cells per box side give room for spatial sampling. Cap limits remote work, spacing spreads observations across blocks without claiming independence.
forest_rule: Every one of 25 fixed 20 m support centres has lossyear 21. Target greenness_loss confirmed in calendar 2021; no subannual onset inferred.
water_rule: At each of 25 sample centres the July-September 2020 and March-May 2021 epochs must agree, and July-September 2021 must reverse. Require >=2 of 3 months observed in each epoch, every observed month must agree, all centres must agree on direction. Monitor June-September inclusive. No-data never dry. Report timing interval uncertainty.
outcome: At least one direction-matched confirmed episode in the registered monitoring interval. Count each labelled cell once and retain all misses, abstentions and empty boxes. Observability requires an observed target-signal series. Report case and region counts, conditional sensitivity, dates, first usable image, delay bounds where available. No daily truth, prevalence, precision or global event-level skill inferred.
